candidate: 7895a64 plus whole-super-frame handoff and unified worker quotas
notes: Fresh namespaces and processes per observation; no owned builds or tests overlap load.
Goodput excludes drain; missing, reordered and drop counters include drain. Daemon/thread CPU is measured over the load interval; receiver CPU includes its two-second drain.
TAP and socket counters count SKBs, which can contain many logical frames/datagrams.
QinQ uses strict hashing; single-tag ordinary UDP retains its existing reader-local policy.
Reordering rises in QinQ under load and remains unexplained. The source handoff test preserves ordering; this does not establish end-to-end ordering.
These runs improve delivery and show a plateau within this sweep, but do not meet the 20 Gbit/s or under-1%-missing gate.
